mission: Implement capability discovery, load-aware assignment, and message ordering

deliverables.title: Capability Discovery Protocol
deliverables.description: CapabilityRegistry class for auto-registering and discovering agent capabilities with intelligent work matching. SQLite-backed with WAL mode, thread-safe with retry-on-busy.
key_features: register_agent() - Register agent with proficiency-scored capabilities (1-5 scale)
update_capabilities() - Dynamic skill updates during session
find_best_match() - Score-based matching: sum proficiency for matched caps, penalize missing ones
get_team_capabilities() - Aggregate view of team skills
get_capability_matrix() - Full cross-team capability comparison
match_work_to_team() - Best team for a work item, with idle_teams constraint support
deregister_agent() - Cleanup on agent shutdown
get_all_capabilities() - List all registered capability names
deliverables.scoring_algorithm: Sum of max proficiency scores per matching capability per team. Missing required capabilities penalized by 3 points each. Teams with score <= 0 excluded. Sorted descending by score.
integration_points: help_protocol.py auto_assign_idle_teams() - replaces random assignment with capability matching
work_stealing.py - can query capabilities before assigning stolen work

deliverables.title: Load-Aware Work Distribution
deliverables.description: LoadBalancer class for tracking per-team load metrics and distributing work to least-loaded capable teams. Includes backpressure signaling to stop overloading busy teams.
key_features: update_load() - Report active_tasks and queue_depth per team
record_completion() - Track completion rate (completions/minute)
get_load() - Query current load for a specific team
get_least_loaded() - Find least loaded among capable teams (excludes backpressured)
is_overloaded() - Check if team exceeds task threshold
signal_backpressure() / clear_backpressure() - Stop/resume work assignment
get_distribution_report() - Full load overview with totals and averages
Auto-expiry of stale load data (default 5 minutes)
deliverables.load_scoring: active_tasks + (queue_depth * 0.5). Lower is better. Backpressured teams excluded entirely.
integration_points: work_stealing.py - check load before assigning stolen work
help_protocol.py - factor load into auto_assign decisions
Any coordinator can report team load and query distribution

deliverables.title: Vector Clocks for Message Ordering
deliverables.description: VectorClock class implementing Lamport-style vector clocks for establishing causal ordering between messages. Lightweight JSON-dict storage compatible with bus.py Message format.
key_features: tick() - Increment local counter, return vector for outgoing message
merge() - Merge received vector with local (element-wise max)
is_before() - Check if v1 happened-before v2 (causal ordering)
is_concurrent() - Check if events are causally unrelated
detect_out_of_order() - Find messages delivered out of causal order
causal_sort() - Topological sort of messages by causal order
to_json() / from_json() - Serialization for persistence
Lightweight: vector stored as JSON dict in message body
deliverables.protocol: On send: tick() and attach vector. On receive: merge(received_vector). is_before/is_concurrent for ordering checks.
integration_points: bus.py Message dataclass - optional vector_clock field in body
BusWriter.publish() - can auto-attach vector clock if VectorClock instance provided
Pipeline stages can verify correct processing order using detect_out_of_order()

capability_discovery: match_work_to_team with and without idle_teams constraint
vector_clock: merge takes element-wise max and increments

architecture_notes.pattern: All three modules follow Proto A patterns: SQLite WAL mode, threading.Lock, _retry_on_busy decorator, context manager support
architecture_notes.thread_safety: All DB operations protected by threading.Lock with retry-on-busy for SQLITE_BUSY resilience
architecture_notes.staleness: LoadBalancer auto-expires stale load data after configurable timeout (default 5 min)
architecture_notes.scoring: CapabilityRegistry uses proficiency-weighted scoring with missing-cap penalties. LoadBalancer uses active_tasks + 0.5*queue_depth composite score.
architecture_notes.vector_clocks: Stateless comparison functions (is_before, is_concurrent) are static methods usable without instantiation. VectorClock instances track per-agent state.
